_about: Data of the bridge set: an iron chain suspension bridge over a river by day (videos/2026-11-07-bridge-break-step), light preset dayExterior. Read by tools/build_props.py (marks, front), src/episode/sets.tsx and tools/check_render.py (light_kind). Marks = feet positions (m). Deck at y 3.2 from x -9 to 9; river along z at y 0; camera side +z.

mark_notes.sign: not a feet mark: the middle of the BREAK STEP notice (camera aim point)
mark_notes.water_corner: not a feet mark: where the left end of the deck hits the water when drop = 1
mark_notes.river_center: not a feet mark: water in front of the bridge (wide shots aim near here)

lights.bounce: deck bounce in time with the marching (0 = still, 1 = full)
lights.drop: the left end of the deck falls into the river (0 = whole, 1 = in the water)
lights.march: soldiers bob in step (0 = standing, 1 = marching)
lights.sign: the BREAK STEP notice at the left entrance (1 = there, today; 0 = hidden, 1831)

_camera_bounds: box the camera must stay inside; presets shorten their distance to fit

review._about: tools/set_review.py: sun + shadow box of the light preset, points that must cast shadows, the sweep's center/radius and light levels
review._far_land: item 8: the far land beyond the near box (|x|,|z| > 42: terrain, far trees, ridges) lies outside the shadow box ON PURPOSE: it is in the capped haze (fogMax), where shadows do not show (references/effects/depth-filling.md)
